_comment: Written by hand: what ships in the Android app and in no lockfile, and SQLite. The versions are those the Gradle files of the app and of the Tauri plugins ask for (app/src-tauri/gen/android and the plugins' android/build.gradle.kts); look again when the plugins are updated. `terms` entries are not a licence notice: they are a service with terms of its own, and the screen shows their name, what they are for and the link. `clarify` gives the licence text of an npm package that ships none.
